name: One architecture, fewer lines, the same capabilities
asks: Leader utterances of 2026-09-10 to 2026-10-09 in pass repos-ci-forest: one architecture, one shared engine, typed functional programming, strictly fewer lines with the same capabilities, tools found before code is written, directives held in the corpus, a planning engine with quoted and typed records, and a repository kept to one branch.

x-provenance.recorded-by: repos-ci-forest pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group's software estate is one architecture of fewer parts with the same capabilities, and the tooling that keeps it so is in the corpus.

requirements.says: The Group's software estate shall implement each capability once, in the shared engine of its owning section.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: 'there's 5+ versions of, when it could be one'; 2026-09-21: 'GET IT SO THERE IS ONE VERSION OF THIS'.

requirements.says: The Group's software estate shall be built on shared typed data classes and functional programming traceable to primitives in computer-data.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 19:29, 2026-09-16: 'typed functional programming, one shared engine across the whole codebase'.

requirements.says: The reduction program shall leave the estate with strictly fewer lines of code, fewer functions and fewer data classes while keeping every underlying capability.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-16: 'strictly fewer lines of code, fewer functions, fewer data classes, while still offering the same underlying capabilities'; the API need not be preserved.

requirements.says: Each consumer of a duplicated capability shall be cut over to the one engine, with no re-export shim left in its place.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: 'ACTUALLY cut over consumers to rely on the real parent package'.

requirements.says: The architecture standardization program shall platformize each normalized module within the ecosystem architecture, not stop at moving it into one module.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12: 'Normalizing our argv use to one module is not the same thing as systematizing, platformizing'.

requirements.says: The duplicate-census tool shall count semantic and syntactic duplicates and every caller of each, and report them by capability.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10, 2026-09-21: thousands of copies; '350+ callers'.

requirements.says: The code-transformation toolchain shall include AST-based codemods for moving callers to the one engine.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: 'WHERE IS OUR FUCKING AST-BASED CODEMOD'; the house holds a codemod term in computer-science.

requirements.says: The tool-discovery service shall give an agent the existing tool for a task before the agent writes new code.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: 'EVERY TIME YOU DIDNT FIND THE TOOL YOU NEEDED BEFORE YOU DID THE WORK IS A FAILURE OF OUR ECOSYSTEM AND YOUR CONFIGURATION'.

requirements.says: The agent guidance system shall project the files agents read from templates that read data files.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 23:00: 'project these files from templates that read data files'.

requirements.says: The agent guidance system shall hold the Leader's directives as structured rule records in the corpus, not as prose files bespoke to one machine.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 23:32: directives turned into 'notes in your private journal'.

requirements.says: Every agent session on the machine shall reach machine resources through the persistent-machine-server so that the server can bound load.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 22:34; 2026-10-06: load 4.8 and a crash-looping script.

requirements.says: The agent permission configuration shall allow agents to change the shared checkout of the sections they lead without a classifier block.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-04: 'too much of your work in this repo is being blocked by your own fucking classifier'.

requirements.says: The agent host configuration shall be reproducible from the corpus so that drift in the repository, user account or host can be detected and repaired.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-04 22:23: 'Through drift you have fucked up your configuration on this box'.

requirements.says: The planning engine shall store each Leader statement as a quote with typed relations to the work it concerns, each naming its relation-kind.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 23:00: 'the leader said <quote>, this relates to <relations, specifying the relation-kind>'.

requirements.says: The planning engine shall run as a single-file, dependency-free Node script exposing an MCP surface and simple web forms, untethered from the estate's other code.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 17:02 (see knowing articulations), and 23:21: 'a single-file robust node script with no dependencies'.

requirements.says: The planning engine shall address records by NI address and treat JSON Schemas as categorical structure open to analysis.
The Group's packages shall be real repositories published as real packages on the Group's registry.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-08 20:19; rule bare-cedar-fog-is-a-superrepo-of-section-repositories.

requirements.says: The repair-wave service shall dispatch software design automation and repair work autonomously across inference models, and shall give each subagent the full context the Group holds on one theory or engineering topic.
The repository steward service shall reduce each repository to one branch, merge or close every other branch and reconcile local and remote.
The branch retirement procedure shall keep no archive of a branch whose work is integrated.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06 03:06: 'We don't need to preserve removed branches are archives if we have the shit integrated. No clutter.'

requirements.says: The release process shall not be an automated release flow.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-08 15:33: 'we do not need some stupid automated release flow'.

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog repository shall be the snapshot of the Leader's dev machine from which agents that run on that machine run.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06 02:21: 'No monorepo. The bare-cedar-fog repo is meant to be the snapshot of this machine, my dev box'.

utterances-added.why: Leader utterances restating this requirement, found NOT HELD or HELD-THINLY in the coverage passes.
